stem.text: What is involved in the mechanism of the reaction between aqueous $\text{NaOH}$ and 1-bromobutane?

A.text: attack by a nucleophile on a carbon atom with a partial positive charge

B.text: heterolytic bond fission and attack by a nucleophile on a carbocation

C.text: homolytic bond fission and attack by an electrophile on a carbanion

D.text: homolytic bond fission and attack by a nucleophile on a carbocation
